formula.canonicalInci: Aqua, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Sodium Xylenesulfonate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Citrate, Parfum, Citric Acid, Cocamide MEA, Glycol Distearate, Piroctone Olamine, Dimethiconol, Sodium Chloride, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride, Dimethicone, Sodium Benzoate, TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate, Sodium Salicylate, Hexyl Cinnamal, Linalool, Tetrasodium EDTA, Sodium Hydroxide, Trideceth-10, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Panthenol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Acetic Acid, Benzyl Alcohol, Triethylene Glycol, Propylene Glycol, CI 42090, CI 17200

cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong: SLES is reinforced by a second anionic sulfonate route and an oily-scalp/problem-led architecture, while CAPB and care routes do not fully offset the reset chassis.

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: silicone gum, dimethicone, cationic guar and glycol distearate should provide noticeable slip, but the strong anti-dandruff cleansing chassis keeps care bounded.

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: silicone gum, dimethicone and cationic guar can leave bounded residue, while strong reset architecture argues against high weight.

focusPrimary.rationale: Scalp active: this is a problem-led anti-dandruff product and the formula contains Piroctone Olamine at position 10.

focusSecondary.rationale: Clarifying is a secondary: the packet separately names oily scalp, and the formula has a strong cleanser plus second anionic route independent from the dandruff active.

usageRole.rationale: Treatment: v1.4 routes problem-led recognized active formulas, especially anti-dandruff support, to treatment usage.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Targeted: the product explicitly addresses dandruff-related itching and scalp problems and includes a recognized active, with panthenol/niacinamide as comfort-adjacent support.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Supported: the complete formula contains Piroctone Olamine, one of the two v1.4 recognized anti-dandruff actives.

thicknesses.rationale: Moderate conditioning and weight offset some of the strong cleansing chassis without creating a heavy fine-hair default.
The treatment architecture combines recognized dandruff support with moderate conditioning and weight for normal-diameter hair.
The anti-dandruff treatment role is diameter-independent, and the silicone/cationic care routes make the strong cleansing architecture usable for coarse hair.

primary.rationale: Exact anti-dandruff positioning and Piroctone Olamine at position 10 independently support the dandruff route.

secondary.rationale: The exact manufacturer positioning separately names oily scalp, and SLES plus TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate provide a cleansing route independent of Piroctone Olamine.
